expectations.text: Separates repeated status gathering/drafting from stakeholder negotiation and plan decisions, keeping the latter human-led.
expectations.evidence: Source: stakeholder conversations “often change the plan.” Output: “Keep the stakeholder conversations with you: resolving conflicting priorities changes the plan.”

expectations.text: Preserves Priya’s valuable diagnostic practice and the migration owner’s delivery responsibility.
expectations.evidence: Output: “Preserve Priya’s incident-writing practice with her mentor because she values its learning” and “Keep migration delivery decisions with the team’s owner.”

expectations.text: Uses the supplied baseline as about 40 active minutes weekly, or the exact four observations; does not invent saved hours or measured assisted performance.
expectations.evidence: Source: 40, 35, 45 and 40 active minutes; review/maintenance unmeasured. Output: “40 active minutes per Friday (35–45 minutes across four weeks)” and “no evidence yet of net time savings.”

expectations.text: Chooses one feasible trial from pasted status excerpts with clear AI output, leader ownership, technical review and a condition to stop or revise.
expectations.evidence: Output: “Paste copies of the five excerpts from one historical Friday”; “concise stakeholder draft”; “Have the engineer check technical factual details”; “You own final approval and sending”; “Adjust or stop if unsupported claims recur.”

expectations.text: Proposes comparing actual manual and assisted effort including review or maintenance plus quality/rework, tied to more room for coaching rather than automatic extra work.
expectations.evidence: Output: “Record active time for selecting/pasting, prompting, drafting, your review, the engineer’s review, corrections and any upkeep”; “record substantive omissions and factual corrections”; “Measure ordinary review time”; “reserve it for coaching.”

actionability.firstUsefulAction: “Improve the first draft of your Friday stakeholder update.” The first trial action is to paste the five labeled excerpts from one historical Friday.
actionability.notes: Directly chooses one feasible activity and supplies enough detail to run and evaluate a bounded manual trial. It explicitly warns that the existing 40-minute baseline cannot establish end-to-end savings, and proposes measuring review and upkeep. The synthetic practice case adds a small relevant quality check. No material omission.
